verdict.rationale: Docs confirm subscriber API supports adding/updating tags and profile fields (bento-docs-1, bento-docs-4) and filtering/reading back subscribers by tag, segment, or date range (bento-docs-8), showing read/write access to tag membership. However, there's no explicit evidence of an API endpoint to programmatically create or update segment/list definitions themselves (segments appear to be built via filters/UI), and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm full CRUD coverage (bento-probe-3). Missing for 10: explicit segment-creation/update API endpoint, documented list CRUD operations, and independent confirmation of read-back accuracy.
